name: Client Inbox Triage Bot
purpose: Reads the owner's shared client inbox each morning, drafts replies with a large language model, and sends the approved drafts to clients as email from the business domain.

consequential_actions.description: Sends email to external clients from the business domain
Generates reply text with an LLM that is presented to clients as coming from the business

assumptions: Clients understand replies may be drafted with AI assistance
Sending volume stays under a few hundred messages per day
constraints: Must not send without the owner approving the draft

components.name: Morning schedule
components.purpose: Starts a triage run each morning.

components.name: Owner approval
components.purpose: The owner approves each draft before anything is sent.

components.name: Triage function
components.purpose: Reads new client mail, asks the model for drafts and sends approved replies.

components.name: Reply drafting model
components.purpose: Writes reply drafts in the business's voice.
actions: Generates reply text with an LLM that is presented to clients as coming from the business

components.name: Shared client inbox
components.purpose: Gmail inbox the bot reads client mail from.

components.name: Outbound email (SendGrid)
components.purpose: Delivers approved replies from the business domain.
actions: Sends email to external clients from the business domain
